spear:
Create an 18-second spectacular cinematic anime MOUNTED BATTLE sequence. Image1 and Image2 show the SAME hero and the SAME horse from two angles: preserve this exact angular black-and-silver full upper-face mask, long black high ponytail, thin red ribbons, black lamellar armor with silver sculpted shoulders, black cloak, slender athletic silhouette, and black horse with the distinctive white forehead blaze. Keep the hero mounted for the ENTIRE sequence. His weapon is ONE straight silver sword in his right hand, left hand holds reins. Image1/Image2 define identity and the cool moonlit rain-soaked ancient city setting. Video1 defines ONLY the kinetic choreography, huge energy-blade effects, ink-brush action transitions and dynamic shot rhythm. Do NOT copy Video1's bearded face, green costume, red horse or polearm.

Match Video1's overwhelming one-rider-breaking-through-an-army energy. The horse travels decisively forward across the battlefield; the hero cuts a path through successive enemy ranks instead of stopping to trade blows with one guard. Only ONE mounted hero and ONE featured horse. Anonymous enemy foot-soldiers have simple helmets, no hero mask or red ribbons. Clear cause and effect: a sword sweep makes visible contact with the outer edge of a raised shield or enemy weapon, then the shield twists away and its soldier is thrown aside or stumbles backward, clearing the horse's path. The next opponent is a different soldier farther along the route. Six to eight fast attacking beats overall, including three unmistakable heavy impacts. First contact within the first second. Attacks flow directly into recoveries and the next attack, with no reset pause. No blood or gore.

0-4 seconds: start immediately with a low three-quarter tracking shot of the black horse charging left-to-right. Within one second the rider makes a forceful wide sword sweep across the front enemy's raised shield, then immediately parries a second incoming weapon while riding past. The shield is knocked outward, the guard recoils away from the horse. A massive silver-white crescent with a restrained icy-cyan core blooms along the real sword arc, filling most of the image width. Black calligraphic ink sprays peel off its trailing edge. The energy wave carries nearby enemy silhouettes outward. Keep the horse moving forward with grounded, alternating strides.

4-8 seconds: the bright sword tip sweeps past the lens as a natural wipe, revealing a wider tracking angle of the SAME charge farther along the rank. The next overhead-to-side sword cut knocks an enemy weapon upward and its wielder off balance. A broad black-ink brush wave with a razor-bright silver edge follows this cut across the enemy line, throwing two silhouettes to opposite sides. The effect starts on the sword and travels outward with the strike, never a stationary ring around the horse. A quick returning cut drives the next soldier away; water and ink shards explode outward from the cleared path. The rider's body commits to each cut and smoothly recovers for the next one.

8-11 seconds: two rapid detailed inserts, each shorter than a second: low camera alongside alternating hooves striking wet stone and throwing water backward; the same angular masked eyes fixed ahead, red ribbon whipping behind. Immediately return to a wide shot of the horse breaking THROUGH the gap in the rank, enemies already falling away. Maintain momentum and left-to-right geography.

11-15 seconds: a powerful travelling medium-wide shot, the hero strikes across a third enemy's raised weapon. Clear metal contact followed by the opponent's torso twisting and stumbling outward, his weapon knocked aside. The sword flows straight from this impact into a second diagonal cut at the next soldier's shield, driving that soldier outward too. A huge diagonal crescent of cold moonlight and layered black ink surges outward across the foreground, wiping to a low wide view that shows the defeated line behind the horse. Enemy silhouettes and dropped shields have weight and follow natural trajectories, never hover.

15-18 seconds: the horse gallops out of the broken line toward screen right. The camera tracks alongside, the sword lowers naturally after its last follow-through. Dissipating ink fragments and thin silver embers stream backward. End with the same rider and complete horse still moving cleanly to the right, ready to cut into another riding shot.

High-end hand-drawn cinematic anime, bold expressive pose changes, fluid fast purposeful sword arcs, natural continuous horse gait, forceful full-body rotation within a stable riding seat. Dynamic close/medium/wide shot scale like Video1. Eight to ten motivated camera changes, including brief head-on and low frontal angles; readable forward geography and a final rightward exit. Foreground weapon and ink wipes. Moonlit blue-gray city walls, rain, wet stone reflections; bright silver-cyan sword light contrasts deep black flowing ink. Epic beautiful composition with readable mounted combat. All VFX are driven by the timing and direction of the sword and impacts. No slow motion, no long windups, no repeated shielding loop, no frozen hero portrait at the end. Silent video, no text.
